title: NeuroGolf worker review-required handoff
description: Structure the worker posts as a JSON comment alongside `hermes kanban block --reason "review-required: ..."`. tools/submit_gate.py parses this to decide submit / retry / give-up. tools/auto_triage_blocked.py::parse_handoff already accepts many legacy shapes (schema-agnostic walker); this schema documents the CANONICAL post-submit-gate shape that workers should produce going forward. It is intentionally permissive (most fields optional) so legacy handoffs continue to validate.

candidate_id.description: Unique candidate identifier, typically '<task>_<variant>_<session_short_sha>'. Required for any handoff that produced an ONNX. Omit (or null) for no-fix / iteration-budget handoffs — submit_gate will treat as 'worker produced no candidate' and consume an attempt without submitting.

worker_owner.description: Profile that produced the candidate. Used by route_repair_cards.py to send repairs back to the original worker.

package_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the submission .zip the worker produced. submit_gate verifies this matches the on-disk file before submitting.

lineage_base.description: Free-form identifier of the candidate this builds on, e.g. 'current-best task141_v4_fp16_pos_t_6856eb96_on_5743_97_20260517T2202Z'. submit_gate.py reads this to check the candidate is still lineage-compatible with the current-best before submitting.

changed_package_entries.description: Entries in the submission .zip that differ from the lineage_base. submit_gate audits the zip against this list to catch the task275 'bundled 401 entries when only one should differ' trap.

scores.description: Score block with current vs candidate cost and the delta. extract_point_delta walks this and several alternative shapes.

expected_point_gain.description: The worker's predicted LB point gain. submit_gate gates submit at >=0.2. May also appear nested as 'selected_repair.expected_point_gain_vs_<task>_<context>' — the schema-agnostic walker handles either.

algorithm_family.description: Short string ID for the algorithm family used. Empty / missing gets normalized to 'unspecified' by tools/algorithm_family_directive.py. submit_gate appends this to task_outcome_registry.attempted_families and uses the accumulated set to forbid repeats on retry.

retry_attempt_index.description: Which attempt this pass: 1, 2, or 3. Set by the autoforeman / submit_gate in the card body; worker copies it into the handoff for audit. After index==3 the task is marked tested_non_improving_this_pass and deferred.

tests_run.description: Human-readable test descriptions the worker ran to validate the candidate. Surfaced in the audit log.

risk_notes.description: Worker's self-disclosed risk concerns. submit_gate scans these for known hazard markers (raw-shape change, novel-family-no-prior-data, etc.) when deciding whether to escalate beyond the routine path.

rejected_attempts.description: Approaches the worker tried and ruled out. Helps the next-pass worker avoid repeating.
